title: Heterogeneous array, scalars before the object - internal sentinel leaks out
rationale: Heterogeneous arrays take MapFlattener Case 3, which splits the array into a base-key column for non-map items and suffixed columns for map fields. On reconstruct the two columns collide and the reconstructor private "_value" wrapper key ends up in user-visible output. Ordering matters, so this is one of a deliberate pair.
catchesBugClass: Namespace leakage of reconstructor internals into output, and positional collapse of heterogeneous arrays. Also pins that padding nulls become observable data rather than being stripped.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the case where a user legitimately has a field named "_value", which would be silently merged with the wrapper. It also cannot distinguish the wrapper leak from the failure to parse the columns, since both are consequences of the same collision.

predicted.detail: Reconstruct processes the base key first as a leaf String, then the suffixed key finds a non-map value already at that node and wraps it, inserting a literal "_value" key into user output.
